name: edusyncra-frontend
description: React build (esbuild). Bundles src/*.jsx into ../static/js/react/. Run: npm install && npm run build. The built bundle is committed so the phone only needs to git pull (no build at deploy time).

scripts.build: esbuild src/spike.jsx src/attendance.jsx src/attendance-app.jsx src/dashboard-app.jsx src/students-app.jsx src/student-view-app.jsx src/student-form-app.jsx src/student-trash-app.jsx src/sales-app.jsx src/library-app.jsx src/events-app.jsx src/admissions-app.jsx src/reports-app.jsx --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2018 --outdir=../static/js/react
scripts.watch: esbuild src/spike.jsx src/attendance.jsx src/attendance-app.jsx src/dashboard-app.jsx src/students-app.jsx src/student-view-app.jsx src/student-form-app.jsx src/student-trash-app.jsx src/sales-app.jsx src/library-app.jsx src/events-app.jsx src/admissions-app.jsx src/reports-app.jsx --bundle --format=iife --target=es2018 --outdir=../static/js/react --watch
